meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序编排多步任务,单阶段逐个执行,失败自动重试并续跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一批互相依赖的任务,需要按先后顺序自动跑完。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a batch of tasks depend on each other and must run in order.

howto.what: 当你提出有先后依赖的多任务时,Claude 会把它定义成任务图(每个节点一个子任务),按依赖分波并行执行并显示状态。某个节点失败或跑偏时,可单独重试、给它发消息或改定义重跑,已完成节点的结果会被复用。
howto.when: 当你说出 “mass-ulw”、要求一张任务依赖图(DAG),或提出某些任务必须先等其它任务完成的分批作业时触发。完全独立的任务直接用普通并行即可,不由它接管。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这几个任务排成依赖图并跑起来
say.note: 会先读规划文档,再定义并启动运行

say.text: 给正在跑的 lint 节点发消息:跳过 vendored 目录
say.note: 运行中的子任务被就地纠正

say.text: 把 audit 节点改成按新规则审计,只重跑它和下游
say.note: amend 只重跑改动节点及其依赖者

howto.what_en: Claude turns your multi-task request into a dependency graph (one node per sub-task) and runs it in dependency-ordered parallel waves with live status. A failed node can be retried, messaged, or amended alone; finished nodes keep cached results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others. Fully independent workers just use plain parallel spawns.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to turn these tasks into a dependency graph and run it.
say_en.note: Reads planning.md first, then defines and starts the run

say_en.text: Send the running lint node: skip the vendored directory.
say_en.note: A running child is steered in place

say_en.text: Amend audit to use the new rules; re-run only it and its dependents.
say_en.note: Only changed nodes and dependents re-run
